page: Running Hono on Alibaba Cloud Function Compute using third-party adapter (rwv/hono-alibaba-cloud-fc3-adapter). Fully managed event-driven serverless compute service. Setup: install hono, hono-alibaba-cloud-fc3-adapter, @serverless-devs/s, esbuild. Entry: src/index.ts with Hono app and handle(app) export. Configuration: s.yaml with FC3 component, region, function name, description, runtime (nodejs20), code path (./dist), handler (index.handler), memorySize (1024), timeout (300). Build: esbuild --bundle to dist/index.js with node platform target. Deploy: serverless-devs s deploy command. AccessKeyID and AccessKeySecret configuration via s config add. Questions: How do I set up Hono on Alibaba Cloud? What's serverless-devs? How do I configure s.yaml? How do I deploy?

sections.manifest: Setup for Alibaba Cloud Function Compute. Install packages: hono, hono-alibaba-cloud-fc3-adapter, @serverless-devs/s, esbuild. Create directory structure: mkdir my-app, mkdir src. Package managers: npm, yarn, pnpm, bun variants. Questions: What packages do I need? How do I set up the project structure?

Hello World application. File: src/index.ts. Import: Hono, handle from hono-alibaba-cloud-fc3-adapter. Create Hono app: new Hono(). Define route: app.get('/', (c) => c.text('Hello Hono!')). Export handler: export const handler = handle(app). Questions: What's the basic app structure? How do I define routes? What do I export?

Serverless-devs configuration. Add credentials: npx s config add (select Alibaba Cloud, enter AccessKeyID & AccessKeySecret). File: s.yaml. Edition: 3.0.0. Configuration options: name, access (default), vars.region. FC3 component: region, functionName, description, runtime (nodejs20), code (./dist), handler (index.handler), memorySize (1024), timeout (300). package.json scripts: build and deploy. Build script: esbuild --bundle --outfile=./dist/index.js --platform=node --target=node20 ./src/index.ts. Deploy script: s deploy -y. Questions: How do I configure serverless-devs? What does s.yaml contain? What build command do I use?

Deployment steps. Build: npm run build compiles TypeScript to JavaScript. Deploy: npm run deploy runs s deploy -y. Commands: npm run build && npm run deploy. Result: function deployed to Alibaba Cloud Function Compute. Questions: How do I deploy? What build steps are needed?
